topic.source_contract: HRA likely significant effect appropriate assessment integrity derogation compensation

scope_guards: Screening out likely significant effects is not treated as planning permission.
An HRA screening conclusion is not treated as an appropriate assessment.
Mitigation is not used to avoid the screening test where law requires assessment.
A plan-level HRA is not treated as project-level assessment.
No adverse effect on integrity is not treated as evidence of delivered mitigation.
Ramsar, SAC, SPA and candidate/proposed sites are not silently conflated.
Derogation tests are not treated as routine planning balance.
No score or promotion is written without exact pathways, screening, assessment, decision, secured mitigation and monitoring evidence.
